title: v0.7.6: Addresses
source_identity_note: The source-stage head adds only documentation to the verified runtime. The exact packaged source revision and artifact hashes must be recorded by the release build; the preview executable below is not a release-package identity.

storage.current_addresses: Complete reverse membership and cached totals at one saved UTXO checkpoint, using shared output facts and the existing 288-transition recovery policy.
storage.historical_outputs: Optional explicit sparse creation ranges, with independent coverage and durable fact ownership after spend or raw-body eviction.
storage.p2pk: Strict compressed/uncompressed SEC public-key destinations identify exact P2PK scripts; P2PKH, alternative encodings and multisignature scripts are not aggregated.
storage.legacy_address_coverage: Conventional-address results remain usable. P2PK requires an explicit current rebuild or historical backfill, and missing coverage never establishes a known zero.
storage.newer_sat_evidence: Presence of Sat state or rebuild archives conservatively defers shared-fact sweeping without blocking healthy UTXO/address commits. This can retain otherwise reclaimable facts and does not migrate experimental Sat formats.
storage.legacy_copies: Retained without automatic removal; upgrading starts no optional address or UTXO build.

checks: Linux runtime build and full Go tests
Vet and release regression race checks
Actual browser and native client regressions
final_linux_development_workflow.scope: Source-built Linux runtime and controlled fixtures; final published Windows/Linux packages and hosted delivery require separate verification.

checks: Current and historical address state, exact balance totals, sparse coverage, pagination and recovery
Strict P2PK points, distinct script balances, legacy coverage upgrade and retained evidence
Preserved newer Sat state/archive facts with healthy UTXO/address writes and ordinary no-Sat collection
Authentic mainnet block-170 P2PK parser regression
focused_windows_addresses_and_compatibil.scope: Focused checks on the final runtime source, not a new full Windows-suite run.

checks: Actual compiled routes and CSS with genuine genesis map and transaction flow
P2PK destination navigation without implicit indexing
Reserved toolbar, narrow and constrained panels, keyboard controls and fullscreen
compiled_windows_preview_navigation.scope: Controlled Chromium against a development preview with no address/UTXO build; the correct balance was unavailable. Not final packaged executable or native WebView sharpness acceptance.

earlier_windows_full_suite.scope: Earlier Addresses implementation with subsequent focused recovery and P2PK checks; no claim of a final-source full Windows rerun.

exact_release_packages_and_installer.required: Freeze the release source, build in a neutral workspace, audit executable versions and installer payload equality, validate header baseline and public updater configuration, then check archive members, provenance and hashes.

exact_release_runtime_acceptance.required: Exercise the exact packaged Windows/Linux clients with disposable fresh and older profiles, authentic data, current/historical and P2PK lookups, offline restart, recovery and private access.

github_prerelease_and_signed_hosted_deli.required: Verify the published prerelease tag/source/assets and authenticated Render downloads, then promote the explicitly approved signed application/header feeds.

published_previous_version_automatic_upg.required: Use the genuine published previous client in a disposable profile; verify automatic download, install and restart into the exact new payload while preserving saved preferences and data.

limitations: Full Bitcoin consensus and script validation remains deferred.
No full-mainnet address build, whole-chain storage benchmark or production-scale speed claim is established.
Historical received totals cover explicit creation ranges and do not establish current balance or complete transaction history.
Balances exclude mempool activity and do not imply wallet ownership or spendability.
Inscription holdings, Sats, snapshot/state exchange and Gateway peerhood are not enabled.
Final release-package execution, system installation, browser registration, antivirus/SmartScreen acceptance and hosted automatic delivery are not established by source checks.
The newer-Sat compatibility guard preserves evidence by retaining additional facts; it does not convert incompatible experimental Sat state.

delivery.saved_update_preferences: Must remain preserved; automatic installation applies to profiles already configured for Automatic.
